config.markdown: Runs, errors, duration and machine metrics of the selected service.

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT round(sum(runs)) AS Runs FROM (SELECT t, duration_count AS runs FROM hud_otel.endpoint_durations WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, duration_count AS runs FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, duration_count AS runs FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service))

tiles.name: Runs vs prev week (%)

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT ifNull(round(100 * ((SELECT v FROM (SELECT sum(duration_count) AS v FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE hour + INTERVAL 1 HOUR > $__fromTime AND hour + INTERVAL 1 HOUR <= $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service))) - (SELECT v FROM (SELECT sum(duration_count) AS v FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE hour + INTERVAL 1 HOUR > $__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 WEEK AND hour + INTERVAL 1 HOUR <= $__toTime - INTERVAL 1 WEEK AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)))) / nullIf((SELECT v FROM (SELECT sum(duration_count) AS v FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE hour + INTERVAL 1 HOUR > $__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 WEEK AND hour + INTERVAL 1 HOUR <= $__toTime - INTERVAL 1 WEEK AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service))), 0), 1), 0) AS `Runs vs prev week`

tiles.description: Runs in the complete hours of the range against the same hours a week earlier.

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT round(100 * (sum(errors) + sumIf(issues, flow_type != 'http')) / sum(runs), 1) AS `Err Rate`
FROM (SELECT t, flow_type, duration_count AS runs, if(startsWith(status_code, '5'), duration_count, 0) AS errors, 0 AS issues FROM hud_otel.endpoint_durations WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT t, flow_type, 0 AS runs, 0 AS errors, issues FROM hud_otel.endpoint_counters WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, flow_type, duration_count AS runs, if(startsWith(status_code, '5'), duration_count, 0) AS errors, issues FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, flow_type, duration_count AS runs, if(startsWith(status_code, '5'), duration_count, 0) AS errors, issues FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service))

SELECT count() AS Flows FROM (SELECT flow FROM (SELECT t, flow, duration_count AS runs FROM hud_otel.endpoint_durations WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, flow, duration_count AS runs FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, flow, duration_count AS runs FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service))
GROUP BY flow HAVING sum(runs) > 0)

SELECT count() AS Functions FROM (SELECT function FROM (SELECT t, function, calls FROM hud_otel.function_counters WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, function, calls FROM hud_otel.function_metrics_lean_1h WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, function, calls FROM hud_otel.function_metrics_lean_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service))
GROUP BY function HAVING sum(calls) > 0)

SELECT uniqExact(instance) AS Sessions FROM (SELECT t, instance FROM hud_otel.process_metrics WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, instance FROM hud_otel.process_metrics_1h WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, instance FROM hud_otel.process_metrics_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service))

tiles.name: Live alerts (firing now; click the flow for its page)

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT 'HudEndpointErrorRateHigh' AS Alert, 'firing' AS State, f.flow AS Flow,
    round(dateDiff('second', nullIf(min(lg.first_seen), toDateTime64(0, 9)), now()) / 60) AS `Active for (min)`, f.service AS Service, ${env:sqlstring} AS Env
FROM (SELECT service, flow, sumIf(duration_count, startsWith(status_code, '5')) / sum(duration_count) AS ratio FROM hud_otel.endpoint_durations
      WHERE t >= toStartOfMinute(now()) - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) GROUP BY service, flow) AS f
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ServiceName AS service, LogAttributes['code.flow.name'] AS flow, min(Timestamp) AS first_seen FROM hud_otel.otel_logs
      WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND EventName = 'hud.forensic' AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'], $env)
      AND LogAttributes['hud.forensic.type'] = 'error' GROUP BY service, flow) AS lg ON lg.service = f.service AND lg.flow = f.flow
WHERE f.ratio > 0.05
GROUP BY f.service, f.flow ORDER BY Flow

tiles.description: Evaluated inline: flows whose 5xx share over the last 5 minutes is above 5% (the HudEndpointErrorRateHigh rule). ClickStack has no AMP ruler.

tiles.name: Runs per minute by flow type

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(t, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AS ts, flow_type AS `Flow type`, sum(duration_count) * 60 / greatest(1, dateDiff('second', ts, least(ts + toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600))), least(toStartOfInterval($__toTime - INTERVAL 1 SECOND, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, 1, 3600))) + toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, 1, 3600)), now())))) AS `Runs/min`
FROM (SELECT t, flow_type, duration_count FROM hud_otel.endpoint_durations WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600 AND t >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND t < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, flow_type, duration_count FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600) AND hour >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service))
GROUP BY ts, `Flow type` ORDER BY `Flow type`, ts WITH FILL FROM toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) TO $__toTime STEP toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))

tiles.name: Err Rate (%): 5xx of HTTP flows, issues of queues and custom flows

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(t, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AS ts, 100 * (sum(errors) + sumIf(issues, flow_type != 'http')) / nullIf(sum(runs), 0) AS `Err Rate`
FROM (SELECT t, flow_type, duration_count AS runs, if(startsWith(status_code, '5'), duration_count, 0) AS errors, 0 AS issues FROM hud_otel.endpoint_durations WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600 AND t >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND t < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT t, flow_type, 0 AS runs, 0 AS errors, issues FROM hud_otel.endpoint_counters WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600 AND t >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND t < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, flow_type, duration_count AS runs, if(startsWith(status_code, '5'), duration_count, 0) AS errors, issues FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600) AND hour >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service))
GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

tiles.name: Flow duration, all flows (ms): Avg / P50 / P90 / P99

config.sqlTemplate:
WITH (q, buckets) -> if(empty(buckets), nan,
  arrayFirst((v, c) -> c >= q * arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))[-1],
    arrayMap((k, n, c) -> exp2((k + 1 - (c - q * arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))[-1]) / n) / 4),
      mapKeys(buckets), mapValues(buckets), arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))),
    arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets)))) AS hud_duration_quantile
SELECT ts, 1e3 * dur / runs AS Avg, 1e3 * hud_duration_quantile(0.5, bk) AS P50, 1e3 * hud_duration_quantile(0.9, bk) AS P90, 1e3 * hud_duration_quantile(0.99, bk) AS P99
FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(t, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AS ts, sum(duration_sum) AS dur, sum(duration_count) AS runs, sumMap(buckets) AS bk
      FROM (SELECT t, duration_sum, duration_count, buckets FROM hud_otel.endpoint_durations WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600 AND t >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND t < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, duration_sum, duration_count, buckets FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600) AND hour >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)) GROUP BY ts HAVING runs > 0)
ORDER BY ts

SELECT toStartOfInterval(t, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AS ts, 100 * sum(cpu_sum) / nullIf(sum(cpu_count), 0) AS Avg, 100 * maxIf(cpu_max, cpu_count > 0) AS Max
FROM (SELECT * EXCEPT t, t FROM hud_otel.process_metrics WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600 AND t >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND t < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT * EXCEPT hour, hour AS t FROM hud_otel.process_metrics_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600) AND hour >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)) GROUP BY ts HAVING sum(cpu_count) > 0 ORDER BY ts

SELECT toStartOfInterval(t, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AS ts, 100 * (sum(memory_sum) / sum(memory_count)) / avgIf(memory_limit, memory_limit > 0) AS Avg,
    100 * maxIf(memory_max, memory_count > 0) / avgIf(memory_limit, memory_limit > 0) AS Max
FROM (SELECT * EXCEPT t, t FROM hud_otel.process_metrics WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600 AND t >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND t < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT * EXCEPT hour, hour AS t FROM hud_otel.process_metrics_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600) AND hour >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)) GROUP BY ts HAVING sum(memory_count) > 0 ORDER BY ts

SELECT toStartOfInterval(t, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AS ts, 100 * sum(elu_sum) / nullIf(sum(elu_count), 0) AS Avg, 100 * maxIf(elu_max, elu_count > 0) AS Max
FROM (SELECT * EXCEPT t, t FROM hud_otel.process_metrics WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600 AND t >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND t < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT * EXCEPT hour, hour AS t FROM hud_otel.process_metrics_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600) AND hour >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)) GROUP BY ts HAVING sum(elu_count) > 0 ORDER BY ts

config.markdown: HTTP, queue and custom flows. Click one for its page.

tiles.name: Flows: HTTP, queues and custom flows — click one for its page

config.sqlTemplate:
WITH (q, buckets) -> if(empty(buckets), nan,
  arrayFirst((v, c) -> c >= q * arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))[-1],
    arrayMap((k, n, c) -> exp2((k + 1 - (c - q * arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))[-1]) / n) / 4),
      mapKeys(buckets), mapValues(buckets), arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))),
    arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets)))) AS hud_duration_quantile
SELECT flow AS Flow, flow_type AS Type, round(runs) AS Runs, round(runs * 24 / greatest(intDiv({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}, 3600000) - intDiv({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}, 3600000), 1)) AS `Runs/Day`,
    round(ifNull(100 * (cur - prev) / nullIf(prev, 0), 0), 1) AS `Runs vs prev week %`, round(100 * ifNull(errs, 0) / runs, 1) AS `Err Rate %`,
    round(dur / 60, 2) AS `Dur Total (min)`, round(1000 * hud_duration_quantile(0.9, bk), 1) AS `P90 ms`, round(1000 * dur / runs, 1) AS `Avg ms`,
    round(1000 * hud_duration_quantile(1, bk), 1) AS `P100 ms`, round(if(e2e_count = 0, 0, 1000 * e2e_sum / e2e_count), 1) AS `E2E avg ms (queues)`,
    round(msgs) AS `Messages (queues)`, service AS Service, ${env:sqlstring} AS Env
FROM (SELECT service, flow, flow_type, sum(duration_count) AS runs, sum(duration_sum) AS dur, sumMap(buckets) AS bk, sum(e2e_count) AS e2e_count,
          sum(e2e_sum) AS e2e_sum, sum(messages) AS msgs, sumIf(duration_count, startsWith(status_code, '5')) AS errs5
      FROM (SELECT t, service, flow, flow_type, status_code, duration_count, duration_sum, buckets, e2e_count, e2e_sum, 0 AS messages FROM hud_otel.endpoint_durations WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT t, service, flow, flow_type, status_code, 0 AS duration_count, 0 AS duration_sum, CAST(map(), 'Map(Int16, UInt64)') AS buckets, 0 AS e2e_count, 0 AS e2e_sum, messages FROM hud_otel.endpoint_counters WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, service, flow, flow_type, status_code, duration_count, duration_sum, buckets, e2e_count, e2e_sum, messages FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, service, flow, flow_type, status_code, duration_count, duration_sum, buckets, e2e_count, e2e_sum, messages FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service))
      GROUP BY service, flow, flow_type) AS m
LEFT JOIN (SELECT service, flow, flow_type, sumIf(issues, flow_type != 'http') AS iss FROM (SELECT t, service, flow, flow_type, issues FROM hud_otel.endpoint_counters WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, service, flow, flow_type, issues FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, service, flow, flow_type, issues FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service))
      GROUP BY service, flow, flow_type) AS i USING (service, flow, flow_type)
LEFT JOIN (SELECT service, flow, flow_type, sum(duration_count) AS cur FROM (SELECT service, flow, flow_type, duration_count FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE hour + INTERVAL 1 HOUR > $__fromTime AND hour + INTERVAL 1 HOUR <= $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)) GROUP BY service, flow, flow_type) AS c USING (service, flow, flow_type)
LEFT JOIN (SELECT service, flow, flow_type, sum(duration_count) AS prev FROM (SELECT service, flow, flow_type, duration_count FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE hour + INTERVAL 1 HOUR > $__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 WEEK AND hour + INTERVAL 1 HOUR <= $__toTime - INTERVAL 1 WEEK AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)) GROUP BY service, flow, flow_type) AS p USING (service, flow, flow_type)
ARRAY JOIN [errs5 + iss] AS errs
WHERE runs > 0
ORDER BY dur DESC
LIMIT 500

tiles.name: Functions in this service, top 100 by total time — click one for its page

config.sqlTemplate:
WITH (q, buckets) -> if(empty(buckets), nan,
  arrayFirst((v, c) -> c >= q * arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))[-1],
    arrayMap((k, n, c) -> exp2((k + 1 - (c - q * arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))[-1]) / n) / 4),
      mapKeys(buckets), mapValues(buckets), arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))),
    arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets)))) AS hud_duration_quantile
SELECT function AS Function, round(runs) AS Runs, round(runs * 24 / greatest(intDiv({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}, 3600000) - intDiv({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}, 3600000), 1)) AS `Runs/Day`, round(ifNull(100 * (cur - prev) / nullIf(prev, 0), 0), 1) AS `Runs vs prev week %`, round(100 * errs / runs, 1) AS `Err Rate %`, round(dur / 60, 2) AS `Dur Total (min)`, if(empty(bk), NULL, round(1000 * hud_duration_quantile(0.9, bk), 1)) AS `P90 ms`, if(cnt = 0, NULL, round(1000 * dur / cnt, 1)) AS `Avg ms`, if(empty(bk), NULL, round(1000 * hud_duration_quantile(1, bk), 1)) AS `P100 ms`, service AS Service, ${env:sqlstring} AS Env
FROM (SELECT service, function, sum(calls) AS runs, sum(errors) AS errs, sum(duration_sum) AS dur, sum(duration_count) AS cnt, sumMap(buckets) AS bk
      FROM (SELECT t, service, function, 0 AS calls, 0 AS errors, duration_sum, duration_count, buckets FROM hud_otel.function_durations WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT t, service, function, calls, errors, 0 AS duration_sum, 0 AS duration_count, CAST(map(), 'Map(Int16, UInt64)') AS buckets FROM hud_otel.function_counters WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, service, function, calls, errors, duration_sum, duration_count, buckets FROM hud_otel.function_metrics_lean_1h WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, service, function, calls, errors, duration_sum, duration_count, buckets FROM hud_otel.function_metrics_lean_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)) GROUP BY service, function) AS m
LEFT JOIN (SELECT service, function, sum(calls) AS cur FROM (SELECT service, function, calls FROM hud_otel.function_metrics_lean_1h WHERE hour + INTERVAL 1 HOUR > $__fromTime AND hour + INTERVAL 1 HOUR <= $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)) GROUP BY service, function) AS c USING (service, function)
LEFT JOIN (SELECT service, function, sum(calls) AS prev FROM (SELECT service, function, calls FROM hud_otel.function_metrics_lean_1h WHERE hour + INTERVAL 1 HOUR > $__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 WEEK AND hour + INTERVAL 1 HOUR <= $__toTime - INTERVAL 1 WEEK AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)) GROUP BY service, function) AS p USING (service, function)
WHERE runs > 0
ORDER BY dur DESC
LIMIT 100

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT Timestamp AS Time, LogAttributes['hud.forensic.type'] AS Trigger, LogAttributes['code.flow.name'] AS Flow, JSONExtractString(Body, 'exceptions', 1, 'executionFlow', 1, 'function', 'code.function.name') AS Function, JSONExtractString(Body, 'exceptions', 1, 'name') AS Exception, LogAttributes['issue.fingerprint'] AS Forensic, ${env:sqlstring} AS Env FROM hud_otel.otel_logs WHERE Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND Timestamp < fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND EventName = 'hud.forensic' AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'], $env) AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 200

config.markdown: One row per SDK session, with its pod, runs, errors and machine metrics.

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(t, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AS ts, uniqExact(instance) AS Sessions FROM (SELECT * EXCEPT t, t FROM hud_otel.process_metrics WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600 AND t >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND t < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT * EXCEPT hour, hour AS t FROM hud_otel.process_metrics_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600) AND hour >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts WITH FILL FROM toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) TO $__toTime STEP toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))

tiles.name: Sessions — one row per SDK session in the range

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT instance AS Session, pod AS `Pod Name`, round(runs) AS Runs, round(100 * errs / runs, 1) AS `Err Rate %`,
    round((up_age + uptime) / 60, 1) AS `Started (min ago)`, round(up_age / 60, 1) AS `Last seen (min ago)`, round(100 * cpu, 1) AS `Max CPU %`,
    round(100 * mem / nullIf(lim, 0), 1) AS `Max Mem %`, round(100 * elu, 1) AS `Max ELU %`, service AS Service
FROM (SELECT service, instance, sum(runs) AS runs, sum(errors) + sumIf(issues, flow_type != 'http') AS errs
      FROM (SELECT t, service, instance, flow_type, duration_count AS runs, if(startsWith(status_code, '5'), duration_count, 0) AS errors, 0 AS issues FROM hud_otel.endpoint_durations WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT t, service, instance, flow_type, 0 AS runs, 0 AS errors, issues FROM hud_otel.endpoint_counters WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, service, instance, flow_type, duration_count AS runs, if(startsWith(status_code, '5'), duration_count, 0) AS errors, issues FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_1h WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, service, instance, flow_type, duration_count AS runs, if(startsWith(status_code, '5'), duration_count, 0) AS errors, issues FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)) GROUP BY service, instance) AS r
LEFT JOIN (SELECT service, instance, max(pod) AS pod, dateDiff('second', max(last_seen), $__toTime) AS up_age, max(uptime) AS uptime, max(cpu_max) AS cpu,
          max(memory_max) AS mem, max(memory_limit) AS lim, max(elu_max) AS elu
      FROM (SELECT t, service, instance, pod, last_seen, uptime, cpu_max, memory_max, memory_limit, elu_max FROM hud_otel.process_metrics WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, service, instance, pod, last_seen, uptime, cpu_max, memory_max, memory_limit, elu_max FROM hud_otel.process_metrics_1h WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, service, instance, pod, last_seen, uptime, cpu_max, memory_max, memory_limit, elu_max FROM hud_otel.process_metrics_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service))
      GROUP BY service, instance) AS s USING (service, instance)
WHERE runs > 0
ORDER BY up_age + uptime ASC
